purpose: Read-only design assessment of attention over executed command sequences and wellness changes for intention goal selection

status: Adversarial design review completed; no implementation launched
finding: PersistentMemory and SelfState multi-horizon sequence learning/replay already exist; preserved branch enables memory and self learning. Specific design gaps include single-event interval memory, endpoint-only changed-window priority, incomplete distinct forecast-channel coverage and conditional whole-motion planner restrictions.
recommendation: Reuse existing persistent memory, self sequence forecasts and replay. Repair transient retention and command/outcome alignment, map bodily channel meanings and forecast coverage, then connect whole-path continuation evaluation to goal choice. Reconcile conditional planner horizon and distance guards; do not duplicate attention or replace the architecture with direct score-trained command weights.
design_constraints: A wellness derivative alone misses sustained harm and treats stable wellness as zero improvement
Do not reward injury followed by relief
Attention weights alone do not establish causal credit
Compare actual catching with the alternative of not catching before blaming the catch for low wellness
Use later observations as teaching targets, never earlier decision inputs
Memory retrieval requires current body/world context; do not blindly replay an old command sequence
next_executable_test_on_resumption: Prepare a managed comparison from preserved same-state copies: controlled imbalance with catch, no catch and a stable alternative. Measure sequence forecast changes, whole-trajectory wellness, selected goal and actual physical outcomes. Confirm a catch is preferred to an otherwise worse fall, and avoiding the fall is preferred to deliberately falling and recovering. Include later-observation perturbation to check temporal causality.
trigger: Explicit operational resumption plus design acceptance and a concrete bounded managed test package
training_impact: No model, learning state, training, or experiment changes made. Design issue does not establish damage to prior training.
